node.statement: Self-contained norm estimate using only validated nodes: node 1.2.2.2 proves for the same explicitly defined rectangles that ||R_k(U)||<=sqrt(3eta)||U||. Since V_1 and V_3 are isometries and u_{3,0} is contractive, ||W||<=||R_1(X^*)|| ||u_{3,0}(B)|| ||R_0(Z)||<=sqrt(3eta)||X|| ||B|| sqrt(3eta)||Z||. Node 1.2.1 gives ||B||=||T(Y)||<=||Y||; hence ||W||<=3eta||X||||Y||||Z||=3eta p. This does not invoke the pending parent 1.2.2 or pending sibling 1.2.2.3.
